title: Officer takes the keys or blocks the vehicle
officerCan: Detain the vehicle itself under s.207 in the specific circumstances that section lists — for example where the rider holds no licence at all.
Impound a driving licence under s.206 in the circumstances that section lists.
officerCannot: Remove the keys from the ignition as a general power — no provision confers it.
Use the keys as leverage to force an on-the-spot cash payment.
Treat a missing physical document as a ground for detaining the vehicle where later production is allowed.

quotableLine.en: If the vehicle is being detained, please tell me under which section, and give me the detention paper.
quotableLine.hi: अगर गाड़ी ज़ब्त की जा रही है, तो कृपया बताइए किस धारा के तहत, और ज़ब्ती का कागज़ दीजिए।

doNotSay: Give me my keys back. (as a demand)
Any attempt to physically take the keys back.
You have no right to touch my vehicle.
documentNow: The moment the keys were taken, and whether any section or paper was cited.

options.label: Calmly ask which section the detention is under.
options.rationale: A lawful detention has a section behind it; taking keys without one does not.
options.tradeoff: Ask once. Do not repeat it as a challenge.

options.label: Ask for the detention memo or challan in writing.
options.rationale: Creates the record that makes this reviewable later.

options.label: Send the trusted-contact alert now.
options.rationale: Key removal often precedes a longer stop.

verification.notes: Placeholder from PRD table. Not checked against bare act. Needs advocate sign-off for legal accuracy AND for escalation risk (PRD R3).
